The quintessence of international cuisine
With four upscale restaurants and bars, panoramic bay views, and professional service, Vinpearl Condotel Nha Trang delivers unforgettable dining experiences through refined local cuisine, fresh seafood, international specialties, premium wines, and creative cocktails.
Coral Restaurant
6:00 - 22:00
0258 359 9099
0258 359 9099
Located on Level 5, Coral Restaurant embraces Mediterranean style with a capacity of 480 guests, boasting impressive ocean views and a diverse international buffet experience.
Lagoon Restaurant
Operate based on occupancy
0258 359 9099
0258 359 9099
Located on the 4th floor of Vinpearl Beachfront Nha Trang, Lagoon Restaurant serves refined Vietnamese and Asian–European à la carte cuisine for up to 150 guests.
Infinity Pool Bar
9:00 - 22:00
0258 359 9099
0258 359 9099
Located on the 6th floor beside the hotel swimming pool, Pool Bar offers 60 seats and a relaxed setting to enjoy sunset and city views, signature cocktails, premium wines, beers, and light bites.
Lobby Bar
6:00 - 22:00
0258 359 9099
0258 359 9099
Located on the ground floor, Lobby Lounge & Bar offers a stylish setting with 40 seats, ideal for relaxing, casual meetings, or coffee dates. Enjoy signature cocktails, homemade cakes, and Beachfront coffee.
